headline: Varroc Engineering: Rochana Tarang Jain discloses acquisition under SEBI SAST Exemption
sum: Mrs. Rochana Tarang Jain (with joint holder Mr. Tarang Jain) disclosed an acquisition of shares in Varroc Engineering Limited under Regulation 10(6) exemption of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure was filed with the NSE on 30 June 2026, indicating a share purchase or increase in substantial holding without triggering a full open offer obligation.
detail: Mrs. Rochana Tarang Jain (holding jointly with Mr. Tarang Jain) submitted a Regulation 10(6) disclosure report to the NSE on 30 June 2026. Under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10 provides specific exemptions to the requirement to make a public announcement and open offer when acquiring shares, subject to strict conditions-including acquisitions from the promoter group or arms-length purchases with regulatory approval. The disclosure document itself (a Regulation 10(6) report) is the formal notification to the stock exchange that the acquirer has satisfied the conditions for exemption. The filing does not specify the quantum of shares acquired, the transaction value, or the exemption sub-clause relied upon; these details would be contained in the full disclosure PDF, which references the NSE corporate team's document store.
